length.description: Only read N bytes from the input; accepts decimal/binary units (e.g., '64', '4KiB')

skip.description: Skip the first N bytes of the input; accepts decimal/binary units (e.g., '1024', '1MiB')

display_offset.description: Add N bytes to the displayed file position; accepts decimal/binary units (e.g., '0x10', '1k')

block_size.description: Sets the size of the `block` unit to SIZE (used in unit parsing)

no_squeezing.description: If true, disables line-squeezing (displays all input lines)
